elements.description: A comment feed with filters, sort, runnable /edit commands, resolving and a composer.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the region's name

properties.name: comments
properties.description: The feed, keyed by id – comments added here show first until they appear in it

properties.name: onRunEdit
properties.description:
Runs an /edit command – resolve when done, reject to show that it failed. Without it the edit is simulated:
marked as applied after a beat (and warns once, unless `demo` is set)

properties.name: onUndoEdit
properties.description:
Reverts an edit that onRunEdit applied – resolve when done, reject to keep it applied with an error. Without it an
applied edit offers no Undo, since the panel can't take it back on its own

properties.name: onAdd
properties.description: A new comment – may return a promise: pending while it runs, a rejection takes the comment out again

properties.name: demo
properties.description: Demo mode: edits are simulated silently when onRunEdit is missing. For galleries and prototypes

properties.name: closable
properties.description: Shows a close button in the header, which fires tc-close

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-comments-change
events.description: A comment was added here, or taken out again when onAdd failed; detail `{ comments: PanelComment[] }` is the whole feed. Cancelable: preventDefault() keeps an added comment out until the app passes it back.

events.name: tc-resolved-change
events.description: A comment was resolved or reopened; detail `{ resolved: string[] }`. Cancelable.

events.name: tc-filter-change
events.description: Another filter was picked; detail `{ filter: CommentsFilter }`. Cancelable.

events.name: tc-close
events.description: The close button was pressed (shown with `closable`)

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the region's name

props.name: onCommentsChange
props.description: The whole feed after a comment was added here (or taken out again when onAdd failed)

props.name: resolved
props.description: Ids of resolved comments – controlled when defined

props.name: defaultResolved
props.description: Resolved ids to start with when uncontrolled

props.name: onResolvedChange
props.description: Called with every resolved id after a comment is resolved or reopened

props.name: filter
props.description: The filter tab – controlled when defined

props.name: defaultFilter
props.description: The filter tab to start with when uncontrolled

props.name: onFilterChange
props.description: Called when another filter is picked

props.name: onClose
props.description: Shows a close button in the header
